$comment: French/English display overlay DECISION-0070 for calc.kinship. Not compiled into CLIR. Working labels stay ru.

AdoptionEffect.text: effect of adoption on the blood branch

AdoptionEffectMissing.text: the adoption policy is not declared

AdoptiveParentAlwaysEffective.text: the adoptive parent is an effective parent under either policy

AncestorStep.text: the parent of an ancestor of depth d is an ancestor of depth d + 1, within the depth cap

BloodParentEffectiveWhenAdded.text: under the “adds” policy, the blood parent is always effective

BloodParentEffectiveWhenNotAdopted.text: under the “replaces” policy, the blood parent is effective until the child has an adoptive parent

CanonicalCandidateFirstLonger.text: canonical count: the degree through a common ancestor is the greater depth

CanonicalCandidateSecondLonger.text: canonical count: the degree through a common ancestor is the greater depth

Cousin.text: first cousin — child of an uncle or aunt

CousinGrandchild.text: cousin grandchild — grandchild of a sibling

CousinGreatGrandchild.text: cousin great-grandchild — great-grandchild of a sibling

CousinNephewOrNiece.text: cousin nephew or niece — child of a first cousin

CousinUncleOrAunt.text: cousin uncle or aunt — first cousin of a parent

CycleDetected.text: cycle in the graph: the person is their own ancestor at a depth greater than zero

DeclaredByAdoption.text: a family with an adoption policy is subject to check

DeclaredByCap.text: a family with a depth cap is subject to check

DeclaredByDegree.text: a family with a degree-count policy is subject to check

DeclaredByEdge.text: a family with a parent edge is subject to check

DegreeCount.text: method of counting the degree of kinship

DegreeCountMissing.text: the degree-count policy is not declared

DepthCapAmbiguous.text: the depth cap is declared twice

DepthCapMissing.text: the depth cap is not declared

DepthCapNotPositive.text: the depth cap is not positive

Family.text: family: a finite graph of persons with counting policies

FamilyWellformed.text: the family is well-formed: no defect is derived

FullSibling.text: full siblings: two common effective parents, distinct persons

Grandchild.text: grandchild — a person whose ancestor of depth 2 is this person

GreatUncleOrAunt.text: great-uncle or great-aunt — sibling of a grandparent

HalfSibling.text: half siblings: exactly one common effective parent, distinct persons

KinDegree.text: degree of kinship — the smallest candidate

LineAscending.text: ascending line: the second person is an ancestor of the first

LineCollateral.text: collateral line: there is a common ancestor, but neither person is an ancestor of the other

LineDescending.text: descending line: the second person is a descendant of the first

MemberAsChild.text: the child is a member of the graph

MemberAsParent.text: the parent is a member of the graph

MemberAsSpouseFirst.text: the spouse is a member of the graph

MemberAsSpouseSecond.text: the spouse is a member of the graph

NephewOrNiece.text: nephew or niece — a person to whom this person is uncle or aunt

RomanCandidate.text: Roman count: the degree through a common ancestor is the sum of the depths

SelfAtDepthZero.text: the person is their own ancestor of depth 0

SelfParent.text: the person is declared to be their own parent

UncleOrAunt.text: uncle or aunt — sibling of a parent

ancestor_or_self.text: ancestor of the person at the given depth; depth 0 is the person themselves

cousin.text: first cousin: child of an uncle or aunt

cousin_grandchild.text: cousin grandchild: grandchild of a sibling

cousin_great_grandchild.text: cousin great-grandchild: great-grandchild of a sibling

cousin_nephew_or_niece.text: cousin nephew or niece: child of a first cousin

cousin_uncle_or_aunt.text: cousin uncle or aunt: first cousin of a parent

degree_candidate.text: degree through one of the common ancestors under the counting policy

effective_parent.text: effective parent link given the adoption policy

family_adoption_effect.text: adoption policy: replaces the blood branch or adds to it

family_declared.text: the family is mentioned by an input and is subject to check

family_depth_cap.text: depth cap of ancestors to which kinship is counted

family_wellformed.text: the family is well-formed for kinship computation

full_sibling.text: full sibling: both parents in common

great_uncle_or_aunt.text: great-uncle or great-aunt: sibling of a grandparent

half_sibling.text: half sibling: one parent in common

kin_degree.text: degree of kinship under the counting policy: the smallest over all common ancestors

kin_line.text: line of kinship: the second person is an ancestor of the first (ascending), a descendant (descending) or collateral

member.text: the person is a member of the family graph

nephew_or_niece.text: nephew or niece: child of a sibling

parent_edge.text: parent edge: by blood or by adoption

spouse_edge.text: spouses (the edge is given one way, read both ways)

uncle_or_aunt.text: uncle or aunt: sibling of a parent
